findings.root_cause: The workflow invoked python kaggle_competitions_automation.py from the repository root, but the script exists under scripts/kaggle_competitions_automation.py. The runner exited with code 2 before the script opened.
findings.exact_error: python: can't open file '/home/runner/work/B-Agent/B-Agent/kaggle_competitions_automation.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory
findings.consequence: The Python script did not execute. The log shows no Kaggle API authentication, competition download or submission occurred in this run.
findings.latent_risk: The workflow scheduled daily at 00:00 UTC, supplied KAGGLE_USERNAME and KAGGLE_KEY, and set KAGGLE_MAX_COMPETITIONS=5. Both repository copies of the script lacked an opt-in guard and call competition_submit. If the path alone were corrected, the script would select up to five active competitions sorted by latest deadline and attempt submissions where rules had already been accepted.

findings.behavior: Manual dispatch reads HF_TOKEN and performs git push -f to the Barrot-Omega Hugging Face Space main branch.
findings.consequence: A manual workflow dispatch can overwrite the external Space branch without a per-run approval gate.

findings.behavior: Manual workflow input accepts new_token, interpolates it into a gh secret set command, writes DATABRICKS_TOKEN and dispatches the Databricks deployment workflow.
findings.consequence: A credential is handled through workflow input and shell interpolation, followed by a consequential deployment dispatch.

changes: Disable the Hugging Face force-deploy workflow with permissions empty and no token access or force-push.
Disable Databricks token rotation with permissions empty, no token input, no secret read/write and no deployment dispatch.
Remove the Kaggle daily schedule; require manual boolean opt-in defaulting false.
Require a comma-separated exact competition allowlist; reject empty, duplicate, malformed or over-cap allowlists.
Require both explicit opt-in and a non-empty allowlist before Kaggle API authentication.
Filter active competitions to the exact allowlist before downloading or training.
Recheck the exact competition slug immediately before competition_submit.
Apply the same guarded implementation to scripts/kaggle_competitions_automation.py and the duplicate barrot_agent/tools/kaggle_competitions_automation.py.
Add fake-API tests; tests do not authenticate to Kaggle or submit anything.
Register the external-workflow safety tests in core CI.

prior_proposal.note: The prior branch is mergeable but stale. The fresh-main successor reapplies the containment to the current main commit and adds exact per-competition approval.

next_actions: Retain the exact competition allowlist and opt-in guard; do not restore a scheduled submission path.
Keep Hugging Face force deployment disabled until separately approved.
Keep Databricks token rotation/deployment disabled until a safer credential-rotation workflow is designed and approved.
Do not merge PR #1539 without user approval.
